_forecast_note: CXCO ramped from a near-zero baseline (3/1/2/11/35 epics per release), so the 5-release regression under-predicts (it gives 33). Kobi set the forecast to committed 26.4 scope = 43.
_bug_exclusions_note: A batch of 65 accessibility defects labelled DWP_Accessibility_Defect was filed on 2026-08-04. They are excluded to stay on the same basis as this chart's [Accessibility] summary exclusion -- counting them read 76 open instead of 11. `OR labels is EMPTY` matters: a bare `labels !=` also drops every issue with no labels at all.
bug_exclusions: AND (labels != DWP_Accessibility_Defect OR labels is EMPTY)
_ai_note: Starts in January like PMN, so the full-year ramp is visible and every month the Power BI report has can be reconciled. An April start was arbitrary -- the report shows 2 epics resolved in March 2026, so 'history starts in April' was not true.
_ai_fields_note: Re-enabled 2026-08-30: CXCO started populating cf[15262] (PR-URL) in August 2026 -- only 5 issues had it Apr-Jul combined, but 48 in August alone. The prior 'hasn't instrumented those fields yet' omission was accurate when set (2026-08-06) but went stale once the team started using the field.
_recipients_note: Recipient addresses are NOT in this file -- the repo is public. Managers come from the CXCO_DASHBOARD_RECIPIENTS secret (semicolon-separated); the test audience comes from PMN_DASHBOARD_TEST_RECIPIENT (shared -- it is just Kobi's review copy).
_first_send_date_note: Same cadence and start as PMN: Mon & Thu, first manager send Mon Aug 10 2026. Without this the cron would have fired Thu Aug 6.
_edct_note: EDCT computed from Jira changelogs (edct_from_jira.py), not the Power BI snapshot. Validated 2026-08-06 against powerbi_snapshot_cxco.json: Apr/May/Jun/Aug match exactly (22/18/13/13); July reads 17 vs the snapshot's 18 because a 19th epic was flagged Implemented-by-AI after the snapshot was taken and it has 0 counted days, moving the mean from 18.1 to 17.2. The live figure is the correct one.
